description: GRAPH-RESIDENT: TIER 3 (imagination/counterfactual, model the collapse INDEPENDENT of the external reference frame) authored by the jabberwock via the composer (CLAUDE.md discipline: no hand-written agent rule). domains/imagination.py is the MECHANICAL machinery (snapshot / cut grounded_in / inject hypothesis / tick / diff / reground / gated commit) -- pure host I/O, never an agent decision, per that module's own docstring. THIS seed is the agent's OWN decision about WHEN to imagine and WHAT to do with the result, mirroring composer_grounding_guard_graph.json / composer_escalation_gate_graph.json's dual-process-arbitration shape exactly: mints THREE rules from an agent -wants_imagination_rule-> ComposeRequest trigger (ground_concern's 'imagine' relation head, seeds/relation_vocabulary.json's new imagine_counterfactual cue + seeds/composer_dispatch.json's new ComposerCue). (1) engage_imagine_grounding_gap_<tag> matches every agent -surprised_by-> impasse -about_gap-> gap edge (the SAME grounding_gap-kind Impasse composer_grounding_guard_graph's own escalate rule mints) not yet imagine_requested, and -- INSTEAD of letting the escalation only re-grind via seeds/autonomy.json's standing mint_goal_from_surprise -- mints an ImagineRequest{status: requested, kind: grounding_gap, hypothesis_template: a JSON-encoded counterfactual ('does the confident-but-ungrounded conclusion survive if I explicitly QUESTION it'), why} wired -focuses_on_gap-> gap (so the mechanical host hook, domains/imagination_dispatch.py's scan_and_imagine, can resolve the GroundingGap's own `node` attr to the concrete focus -- add_edge targets must be match-bound vars, so the rule cannot point directly at a node it never matched) and -about_impasse-> imp, then marks imp.imagine_requested so a re-run never re-imagines the same impasse (the SAME fixpoint-safety idiom gap.escalated / ax.cost_escalated already use). (2) engage_imagine_cost_worth_<tag> is the twin for the OTHER escalation arm: matches every agent -surprised_by-> impasse -about_axis-> ax edge (the cost_worth_refining-kind Impasse composer_escalation_gate_graph's own escalate rule mints) not yet imagine_requested, mints the SAME ImagineRequest shape (kind: cost_worth_refining) wired -focuses_on_axis-> ax directly (no extra indirection needed -- the CapabilityAxis IS the focus), marks imp.imagine_requested. (3) judge_imagined_conclusion_<tag> is the RETURN-PATH rule: matches every agent -produced_imagination-> imagination -imagined-> conclusion edge (the durable trace domains/imagination.py's imagine() mints on the live graph PLUS the produced_imagination edge the host hook adds once it runs the request -- imagine()/reground() are Python host calls that cannot execute inside a Rust rule effect, exactly why the hook exists, the SAME reason domains/experiment_dispatch.py spawns a child process the rule engine can't spawn itself) whose OWN status (written by reground(), not by this rule) is 'survived' and not yet acted -- and marks it acted + requests a gated commit (agent -wants_to_commit-> imagination; domains/imagination.py's commit_imagination stays the ONLY path that ever writes imagined content into the live graph, and it still requires an explicit approver -- this rule only REQUESTS, never blindly commits). A 'discarded' conclusion (reground's own verdict: it contradicted a grounded live fact) matches NO effect here -- dropped, no action, by construction (the rule's own where-guard), not by a second rule that has to remember to do nothing. Trust is the default; imagining is what a genuine escalation earns; committing is what a genuine survivor earns. EXTENDED (TIER 4 integration, seeds/composer_collapse_watch_graph.json's predict_intervene_<tag> rule): rn1's (engage_imagine_cost_worth_<tag>) kind-guard widened from a single Eq to an Or of two Eq arms so a `predicted_divergence`-kind Impasse (minted when domains/collapse_model.py's CollapseModel says converged=False -- the whole-graph forward-look predicts the volatile frontier will grow without bound) ALSO engages tier-3 imagination, not only cost_worth_refining -- predict_intervene wires its Impasse -about_axis-> the CollapseModel node itself (the un-checked add_edge target type is not enforced, so this reuses the existing focus-resolution path in domains/imagination_dispatch.py's `_resolve_focus` without needing a new focuses_on_model case there). Deliberately did NOT touch rn1's `match` or `effects` (the minted ImagineRequest's own `kind` attr stays the literal 'cost_worth_refining' even when triggered by a predicted_divergence impasse) -- tests/test_imagination_cognition.py::test_agent_authors_engage_and_judge_rules_via_graph_composer pins that literal exactly, and the semantic bridge only needed the guard widened, not the label.

effect.why: a confident-but-ungrounded snap was escalated -- imagine whether the conclusion survives a detached, groundless re-derivation before trusting it
the cheap frontier pick's residual*value was judged worth refining -- imagine whether it survives a detached, groundless re-derivation before spending the refinement cost
